caption: The drawing features a rectangular panel centered on a blank, beige background. Inside the panel, outlined with a thin red and yellow border, there are ornate and colorful decorative elements. The objects and characters within the panel are primarily stylized, featuring abstract floral motifs and elements that resemble the letters "S T S" from left to right. Each letter is decorated with patterns and colors including blue, yellow, red, green, and hints of brown and black. The internal designs of the letters include checkerboard patterns, dots, and lines. There are two stylized flower-like shapes between the letters, one circular and multi-petaled with a red center and blue, green, and yellow petals, and another resembling a red tulip with a green stem. The panel is set against a plain parchment-colored background with the name "ALBERT LEVONE" inscribed in small, black capital letters just below and to the right of the rectangular panel.
title: Pa. German Book Marker
